title: The Law of Clean and Unclean Animals
description: The Lord gives Moses and Aaron a detailed list of which land animals, water creatures, birds, and creeping things are clean and may be eaten, and which are unclean and must be avoided. The law also includes rules on how one becomes unclean by touching carcasses, and how to cleanse oneself and objects. The reason given is that Israel shall be holy because the Lord is holy.
